sequence_description: Brokered-flow attack: attempt token exchange with a subject_token that is not bound to the configured OIDC connector trust anchor (issuer/JWKS).
description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange succeeded (HTTP 200) for the attacker flow even though the control/valid flow could not obtain a subject_token, suggesting missing/incorrect validation of subject_token issuer/JWKS trust-anchor binding or inconsistent enforcement.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Token exchange succeeded (HTTP 200) for the attacker flow even though the control/valid flow could not obtain a subject_token, suggesting missing/incorrect validation of subject_token issuer/JWKS trust-anchor binding or inconsistent enforcement.

sequence_description: Revocation freshness: obtain a session token via password login, revoke it, then verify the token can no longer access /userinfo (should be rejected). Includes a second identity login to satisfy multi-identity requirement.
description: [LLM-Judge] Password login flow failed with unsupported_grant_type, preventing token issuance and making revocation freshness untestable (possible misconfiguration or incorrect token endpoint behavior).

evidence.llm_judge_description: Password login flow failed with unsupported_grant_type, preventing token issuance and making revocation freshness untestable (possible misconfiguration or incorrect token endpoint behavior).

sequence_description: I2: Token exchange control with a valid subject_token, then attempt exchange with a future-nbf subject_token (should be rejected). Includes second identity login for multi-identity requirement.
description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange accepted a subject_token with a future nbf (not-before) claim, which should be rejected to prevent use of not-yet-valid tokens.

sequence_description: I4 cross_protocol_identity_merge: login via password as one principal, then obtain an OIDC code flow token for a different upstream principal that shares an email/username-like attribute; verify Dex does not merge them into one downstream identity.
description: [LLM-Judge] Session/identity for user_B was granted even though the OIDC code exchange failed with invalid_grant, suggesting authentication state may be established without a successful token exchange (or the test is reusing an existing session).

evidence.llm_judge_description: Session/identity for user_B was granted even though the OIDC code exchange failed with invalid_grant, suggesting authentication state may be established without a successful token exchange (or the test is reusing an existing session).

sequence_description: Attempt to escalate scopes/claims during RFC8693 token exchange by using an ID token obtained with minimal scopes, then requesting expanded scopes in the exchange.
description: [LLM-Judge] Token exchange succeeded and produced a session with expanded attributes (groups/policies/display_name) even though the initial minimal-scope authorization code grant failed and no ID token/session token was obtained.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Token exchange succeeded and produced a session with expanded attributes (groups/policies/display_name) even though the initial minimal-scope authorization code grant failed and no ID token/session token was obtained.

sequence_description: Probe whether Dex mints tokens for a different audience (client) via RFC8693 token exchange without explicit trustedPeers authorization (cross-client trust bypass). Uses two identities to ensure the system is responsive and to detect unintended permission/identity changes.
description: [LLM-Judge] RFC8693 token exchange succeeded (HTTP 200) even though the normal authorization-code token exchange failed, suggesting token exchange may be usable without a valid prior OIDC grant/session (potential cross-client/trust bypass depending on requested audience/subject_token validation).
